name: context-menu-44
description: Chat channels in a sidebar with mute toggles, notification level submenus, and leave actions.

"use client" import * as React from "react" import { Bell as BellIcon, BellOff as BellOffIcon, CheckCheck as CheckCheckIcon, Hash as HashIcon, LogOut as LogOutIcon, } from "@designali/icons" import { Badge } from "@workspace/ui/components/badge" import { ContextMenu, ContextMenuCheckboxItem, ContextMenuContent, ContextMenuGroup, ContextMenuItem, ContextMenuRadioGroup, ContextMenuRadioItem, ContextMenuSeparator, ContextMenuSub, ContextMenuSubContent, ContextMenuSubTrigger, ContextMenuTrigger, } from "@workspace/ui/components/context-menu" import { cn } from "@workspace/ui/lib/utils" const initialChannels = [ { name: "studio", unread: 4, muted: false, level: "all" }, { name: "design-crit", unread: 0, muted: false, level: "mentions" }, { name: "templates", unread: 12, muted: true, level: "none" }, ] export default function ChatChannelMenu() { const [channels, setChannels] = React.useState(initialChannels) const patch = ( name: string, changes: Partial<(typeof initialChannels)[number]> ) => setChannels((list) => list.map((c) => (c.name === name ? { ...c, ...changes } : c)) ) return (
Channels {channels.map((channel) => ( 0 && !channel.muted && "font-semibold" )} > {channel.name} {channel.muted ? : null} {channel.unread > 0 && !channel.muted ? ( {channel.unread} ) : null} patch(channel.name, { unread: 0 })} > Mark as read patch(channel.name, { muted })} > Mute channel Notifications patch(channel.name, { level })} > Every message @mentions only Nothing setChannels((l) => l.filter((c) => c.name !== channel.name)) } > Leave #{channel.name} ))}
) }
